Durıng ramadan 1 have seen some people offerıng taraweeh ıe 4 rakat wıth 1 salam ıs ıt permıssıble on daıly basıs. Kındly guıde. 4908 views Q. Earlier in our masjid we used to stand as the Imam sahib entered and the Iqama was given and then we prayed normally. Now since many months the Imam sahib has started reciting Hadith from a book of selected Hadiths when he comes for Fardh Salat. Till then we sit down and wait for the Hadith to be completed and then we stand up and Iqama is given. I fear if this is an innovation (biddah) and if other masjids too starts following this way of reciting Hadith when Imam comes to lead for prayer then it may create confusion among people. Kindly let me know if this practice is correct or should be avoided? 1835 views Q. Salah 1815 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 39413 Country: India Title: Should I not turn the sleeves of shirt or pant at the time of offering prayer Question: Should I not turn the sleeves of shirt or pant at the time of offering prayer? Answer ID: 39413 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 978/587/L=1433) It is makrooh to fold the sleeves of shirt and paint in the state of salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
